Name: CalendarLens
Author: RedoClouds
Description:
CalendarLens is a personal calendar journal for dates you discover and reminders you add. Bookseller dates remain unknown until you open a native calendar, then the dates for that month are recorded. Your journal is separate for each save and player, with space for 48 months and 100 reminders per month.

[b]Using CalendarLens[/b]
Press F10 to open or close the journal. Use Up/Down or the D-pad to scroll and Escape/B to close. The panel does not pause the world. Change OpenKey in config.json to choose another key.

In the SMAPI console, use calendarlens note <day1..28> <text> to add a current-month reminder, calendarlens remove <number> to remove one, or calendarlens help for help.

CalendarLens records bookseller dates only from native calendars with calendar-day data, not Help Wanted boards. Opening its own journal does not reveal dates or inspect future months. It does not change other mods’ calendars.

[b]Installation[/b]
Requires desktop Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer. Extract CalendarLens into Mods and keep the included Quicksan.Stardew.Common.dll beside CalendarLens.dll. No other mod is required.

Journal entries are kept in this mod’s data folder, separately from game saves. Keep a copy of that folder if you want to retain your journal when uninstalling.

If you find bugs or problems, please report them through the Bugs or Posts tab so we can fix them. Feature requests and suggestions are welcome. Include versions and reproduction steps, and remove private information from logs.
